title: Toggle Todo
prompt: A React todo list needs an immutable state update. Write a helper that returns a new todo array where only the todo with the matching id has completed flipped.

explanation.beginner:
Example: toggleTodo([{"id":"1","text":"Ship","completed":false},{"id":"2","text":"Rest","completed":true}], "1") produces [{"id":"1","text":"Ship","completed":true},{"id":"2","text":"Rest","completed":true}]. Choose the targeted field or record, create its new state, and preserve unaffected values from the previous state.

Compare “leaves other todos alone”: input [[{"id":"1","text":"Ship","completed":false}],"missing"] produces [{"id":"1","text":"Ship","completed":false}]. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
explanation.junior:
Choose the targeted field or record, create its new state, and preserve unaffected values from the previous state.

Tempting mistake: Mutating the previous state can corrupt undo and comparisons. Copying only the outer collection still shares nested objects.

The reference uses map. Trace the intermediate value after each operation; count repeated scans inside callbacks separately when estimating cost.

Regression check: preserve the contract illustrated by “leaves other todos alone”, then change one boundary in a new test. The solution below is one implementation; another is valid when it preserves the same behavior.
